purpose: Make DigitalHut own niches by proving that visitors complete richer experience cycles than competitor frameworks provide.
source: last-known production metric snapshot; not live-rechecked by backend SEO standby system

lastKnownMetrics.source: last-known production metric snapshot; not live-rechecked by backend SEO standby system

cycleStages.label: Auto Play
cycleStages.seoMeaning: Visitor allowed the observatory to begin instead of treating the page as a static article.

cycleStages.label: 3D GLB Open
cycleStages.seoMeaning: Visitor inspected the functional layer competitors usually do not have.

cycleStages.label: 3D Rotate / Zoom
cycleStages.seoMeaning: This is the strongest proof that DigitalHut is being used as a tool, not just viewed as media.

cycleStages.label: Podcast / Source Moment
cycleStages.seoMeaning: Visitor accepted a source-authority interruption inside the video/research flow.

cycleStages.label: System Search
cycleStages.seoMeaning: Visitor trusted the system enough to ask it a follow-up question.

cycleStages.label: Category Aspect Check
cycleStages.seoMeaning: Visitor moved from one niche post to another, proving the cluster can branch.

cycleStages.label: Blog / Watch Proof
cycleStages.seoMeaning: Visitor crossed from entertainment into crawlable proof content.

nichePosts.occupiedPost: DigitalHut proves the subject with a video-linked Babylon/GLB inspection layer.
nichePosts.cycleGap: Need rotate/zoom receipts to prove hands-on inspection, not only model opening.
nichePosts.pushAction: Keep this as the lead post until GLB manipulation and source clicks are measured.

nichePosts.occupiedPost: DigitalHut sits between raw video and research, explaining what the content means with sources and backlinks.
nichePosts.currentEvidence: 14 blog proof views and 2 podcast/source moments
nichePosts.cycleGap: Need source/backlink clicks and same-topic watch/blog continuation.
nichePosts.competitorToBeat: single-medium video page and static explainers
nichePosts.pushAction: Use watch/blog pairs around specific videos, not broad entertainment keywords.

nichePosts.occupiedPost: DigitalHut should let visitors search after the system forms an opinion from video, GLB, and source context.
nichePosts.cycleGap: Search is quiet, so the system needs clearer prompts and proof of what search can do.
nichePosts.competitorToBeat: generic search result pages and Q&A pages
nichePosts.pushAction: Hold scale. Seed intent examples in proof routes until visitors search.

nichePosts.occupiedPost: DigitalHut should make one completed experience branch into related category lanes.
nichePosts.currentEvidence: category aspect events not present in last-known local snapshot
nichePosts.cycleGap: Need category lane selected receipts and next-episode/category continuation.
nichePosts.pushAction: Capture category hop events before expanding more category SEO.

ownershipGates.passRule: Any real cycle stage has measurable behavior and a crawlable proof route exists.
ownershipGates.nextMove: Keep the post active and measure which event pulls the visitor deeper.

ownershipGates.passRule: At least three cycle stages fire in the same niche family.
ownershipGates.nextMove: Connect GLB proof, blog proof, and podcast/source moments into the same niche page family.

ownershipGates.passRule: Cycle score passes 55 and proof depth beats competitor framework score.
ownershipGates.nextMove: Scale only after source/backlink, rotate/zoom, search, or category-hop receipts improve.

nextSystemMove: Occupy the 3D visual proof post first, add rotate/zoom and source-click receipts, then return between runs to decide whether the niche post pushes, holds, rewrites, or moves to stronger competition.
